rationale.ai-review: LLM agents autonomously judge applications through adaptive penetration testing.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Concrete exploit execution supplies deterministic pass/fail validation for candidate findings.
rationale.agent-scope-drift: Bounded actions, budgets, isolation, and ethical constraints contain agent behavior.
rationale.oversight-scaling-inversion: AI-accelerated development outpaces manual security assessment capacity.
rationale.framework: Reusable coordinator-sandbox-validation architecture supports continuous security-testing pipelines.
rationale.built-system: Open-source MAPTA ran benchmarks and scanned ten real repositories.
rationale.general-code: Targets ordinary web applications, not specifically AI-generated code.
rationale.risk-security: Evaluates vulnerability detection and reports nineteen real-repository security flaws.
rationale.method-mining: Scanning real repositories produced findings characterizing their vulnerabilities.
